content.text:
I fixed the pricing page for phones by adding `.plans` to the mobile rules in `site/css/pages.css`. Below 720px the three plan cards (Starter, Pro, Team) now stack in one column. Before, they stayed in three columns and were squeezed onto the narrow screen.

The 16 functional tests pass. I didn't check the page in a phone-sized browser, so please look at it on your phone. The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see what the "last change" was. I found the problem by reading the CSS.

STATUS: DONE
